question: What immense wealth is imagined as insufficient compared to this teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels is imagined
The comparison implies a higher value
inference: Even wealth enough to fill the ocean with jewels is less than this teaching.
uncertainties: ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is a difficult fused form and may contain an infinitive.
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to fill the ocean with jewels.
